testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.wiring.DataManagementNegativeSecurityTests

testcase.name: a recognisable secret fed through every route that can carry one appears nowhere()
the mounted routes are exactly the frozen list - no project-scoped definitions, no browser mutation route()
no raw mutation route answers, with the platform on()
an authority or unknown key is refused in every body of every route()
the application is not configured to log request bodies - the web framework is not at DEBUG or TRACE()
a body that is not a JSON object is refused 400 on every body route()
toString of every request and domain object leaves out secrets and bodies()
an actor that is not a USER is denied by every service, whatever role its user id holds()
